name: Lyrion Dashboard
tagline: Now-playing dashboard with synced lyrics for Lyrion Music Server
blurb: Companion app for the Lyrion Dashboard web app, a self-hosted now-playing view for Lyrion Music Server (formerly Logitech Media Server / Squeezebox).
description:
Companion app for the Lyrion Dashboard web app, a self-hosted now-playing view for Lyrion Music Server (formerly Logitech Media Server / Squeezebox).

Features:

* Now playing: cover art, title, artist and album of the active player, refreshed live, with an accent colour derived from the cover
* Synced lyrics displayed karaoke-style, with manual scrolling and a resume-auto-scroll control
* Library statistics (albums, artists, plays, genres, ...)
* Automatic discovery of the Lyrion server on the local network
* Keeps the screen on while the dashboard is displayed (configurable)

This app requires a running Lyrion Dashboard server instance on your network — see the project page for server setup.
